minimumOS.visibleChecks: Reservation editor Done works for all three fields. Review includes the selected date and entered purpose. List and Grid preserve the same identities, and the entries reopen after relaunch.

candidate.scope: English and Spanish navigation, exact Grid meal and day-note taps, Back and tab return, cross-week move with the original lunch date, relaunch and the parent week after a pickup switch. This candidate preceded the reservation-editor guard.

reservationBaseline.scope: The open reservation retained the first pickup's draft and Review protected need after the app switched to a second pickup. One UI regression failed on the candidate with only its test added.

integrated.scope: The normal English reservation flow passed. Switching pickups replaced the still-open editor with the pickup-change notice, removed its review action and opened a fresh reservation from the newly selected pickup.
